candidates.summary: Republican nominee and sergeant with the Franklin County Sheriff's Office, where he has worked since 1996 {wrbi_henson}.
background: Sergeant with the Franklin County Sheriff's Office (promoted 2017); began as a jail officer in 1996 and became a deputy in 1999 {wrbi_henson}.

Supervises the office's evening shifts and administers the Indiana Traffic Safety Grant (Operation Pull Over); has been a law-enforcement instructor since 2004, a K-9 handler and a field training officer {wrbi_henson}.
Earlier worked with the Vincennes University Police Department; associate degree in law enforcement from Vincennes University; Indiana Law Enforcement Academy graduate (1999) {wrbi_henson}.
Received the office's Medal of Valor and Life Saving Award in 2022 {wrbi_henson}.
path_to_ballot: Won the May 5, 2026 Republican primary over Chris Maxie, about 68 percent to 31 percent (unofficial) {noww_primary} {ba_primary}.

items: Said his supervisory roles gave him "extensive experience in budgeting, scheduling, and officer management" {wrbi_henson}.
